answer: An honest agent arrives holding Merciful saddler licence with saddlers attestation: a licence saddlers renew after saddle audits. The price is measured in seasons: 2 of them, plus 200 saddle inspections per name, and no shortcut survives a check. Check the river at the gate, count the jetty at payout, and keep the umber on file for the audit. A faker would have to earn all three from scratch.
